Symbol combinations

1 · Knot + seed of life
The woven knot over the seed of life, the pattern said to stand for creation.
2 · Knot + lotus
The knot rising out of a lotus: something blooming into being.
3 · Knot in a vesica
Two circles crossing (where new things begin), holding the knot.
4 · Knot + sun
The knot in its ring, with rays: light and creation.
5 · Knot + spark
A spark lit at the open heart of the knot.
6 · Knot + flower ring
The knot inside a ring of seed-of-life petals.
7 · Triskele
The Celtic triple spiral, the triquetra's cousin: growth and motion.
8 · Triskele + knot
Triple spirals turning around a small woven knot.
9 · Lotus + seed
A lotus blooming inside the seed of life.
10 · Vesica spiral
A spiral of growth inside the vesica.
11 · Knot + seed (pink/purple)
Same as 1 in purple and pink, to compare.
12 · Lotus knot (pink/purple)
Same as 2 in purple and pink.
